description:
The 2013 version of Cruel Winter, the first version of the sequel to 2012's Cruel Summer, is a mystery. No single for this album was released, and most of the info comes from leakers and insiders. It had many songs with A Tribe Called Quest member Q-Tip, who was notably absent from Cruel Summer despite having already been signed to the label. There is no known cover for this album, so we're using a fanmade cover to represent this era.

(09/14/2012) (Cruel Summer officially releases)
